grades.label: Continuance Requirement for Chemistry Majors
grades.text: After a student has completed 20 units in Science, a Science cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of not less than 2.20 is required for continuance as a Chemistry Major.

grades.label: Continuance Requirement for Chemistry Majors
grades.text: Students whose Science CGPA falls below 2.20, will be sent a warning letter and, if after the subsequent term of study the Science CGPA remains less than 2.20, the students shall be withdrawn from the Chemistry Major.

grades.label: Continuance Requirement for Chemistry Majors
grades.text: This does not preclude re-entry to the program if the CGPA subsequently recovers.

grades.label: Continuance Requirement for Chemistry Majors
grades.text: If, after completing 90 or more units, a student’s Science CGPA falls below a 2.20, but remains above 2.00, the student will be allowed to complete the Major.
